title.narrative: Edutubers Engagement for the Dissemination of the 2023 Recommendation

description.narrative: In the last years, teachers are becoming increasingly interested in exploring how to create digital tools to express their voices and foster peer-to-peer communications. Being an edutuber has become a profession itself, that have helped teachers, students and families to understand better about specific themes. Some of them have thousands or millions of followers. Nevertheless, and building on the experience of the office, there are few of them dedicated to themes related to the 2023 Recommendation, and none in particular, talking about it. Building on the recent experience of the Office working on edutubers training with Google as well as with influencer educators who have helped spread the word about initiatives, this workplan aims at engaging current edutubers both to, a) inform and sensitize them on the 2023 Recommendation, and b) have them delivery conferences to training interested teachers to become 2023 Recommendation "certified" Edutubers.
